executed_arm.objective: candidate-episode balanced BCE plus top-1-percent negative-episode tail ranking

sequential_selection_audit.finding: The accumulated DEV-A reuse creates substantial adaptive selection risk even though individual pilot files were frozen before execution.
sequential_selection_audit.action: Stop the predeclared family after A0. Do not execute A1 or A2 on DEV-A. Transfer the direct-current-packet feature hypothesis to a separately frozen temporal development cohort.

interpretation.finding: Episode-tail supervision over the compressed candidate-connected evidence did not suppress the low-threshold false-candidate tail.
interpretation.comparison_boundary: A0 is opened DEV-A exploratory evidence. It is not an independent test and cannot support a cross-network or SOTA claim.
interpretation.next_experiment: Use a fixed-final-epoch two-arm training protocol with identical packet-level losses, differing only by current-packet direct features, and perform selection on a new temporally separated GeoNet development layer.
